name: mycode-ai
description: MyCode-AI - AI-powered code editor based on Code-OSS

scripts.build:extensions: npm run build:extensions:main && npm run build:extensions:chat && npm run build:extensions:agent && npm run build:extensions:completion && npm run build:extensions:review && npm run build:extensions:search && npm run build:extensions:refactor && npm run build:extensions:debug && npm run build:extensions:theme
scripts.watch:extensions: concurrently "npm run watch:extensions:main" "npm run watch:extensions:chat" "npm run watch:extensions:agent" "npm run watch:extensions:completion" "npm run watch:extensions:review" "npm run watch:extensions:search" "npm run watch:extensions:refactor" "npm run watch:extensions:debug" "npm run watch:extensions:theme"
